edges: The debtor may seek to exempt property from the bankruptcy estate by means of this statute.

multi_hop_neighbors.neighbor: Pre-petition Causes of Action for Personal Injuries
multi_hop_neighbors.edge: These causes of action are property of the debtors' estates.
The case holds that the debtors' claims for injuries to the person are property of the bankrupt estate as of the commencement of the case.
